    @Sku NVARCHAR(50),@Name NVARCHAR(200),@Price DECIMAL(10,2),@CategoryId INT
AS BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    MERGE dbo.Products AS tgt

        VALUES(src.Sku,src.Name,src.Price,src.CategoryId,SYSUTCDATETIME());
END;
